description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying {B}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, adding {B}.
When Shipwreck Dowser dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Undying Malice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
